validation sets with an 80/20 split. All target moments and evaluation metrics are computed on the
validation set.

from the covariance matrix. Orientation is represented by the polar angle of the principal axis (in
spherical coordinates), while elongation is defined as the ratio between the largest eigenvalue and the
second-largest eigenvalue.
